🚀 Start here

SPIKE is built around five everyday loops: discover people and topics, publish useful content, talk privately, participate in Rooms, and build long-term progress.

Sign in or create an account

Use an email you can access. New accounts verify through a temporary 6-digit email code.

Complete your profile

Add a display name, username, bio and useful profile details. Your profile is your public identity.

Explore the Feed

Use For You, Discover, Trending, Reels, Nearby, Insights, Progress and Creator tools as available.

Connect and participate

Find people, send friend requests, join Rooms, comment, react and message your connections.

Build your progress

Check in, complete daily tasks, earn XP, maintain a streak and unlock levels, ranks and achievements.

Best first move: make your profile useful, follow people you genuinely care about, and start participating before chasing numbers.

🧭 Where do I go?

Think of SPIKE as a set of connected spaces. Use the destination that matches what you want to accomplish.

📰 Feed

See what is happening, discover content, react, comment and publish.

🔎 Discover

Find people, topics, content and new communities worth exploring.

👥 Friends

Manage connections, requests and people you want to keep in your network.

💬 Messages

Have private conversations and use available voice/video communication.

🏠 Rooms

Join focused communities, participate in discussions, polls and events, and follow Room activity.

👤 Profile

Manage your identity, public presence, posts, progress and profile-level controls.

🏆 Leveling

Track XP, levels, ranks, badges, achievements, streaks, tasks and leaderboard progress.

🔔 Notifications

Review mentions, social activity, connection activity and other account events.

Simple rule: Feed is for discovering and sharing; Messages are for private conversation; Rooms are for communities; Profile is for identity; Leveling is for progress.

🪪 Account & SPIKE identity

Your account is created and authenticated through SPIKE's sign-in flow. Your lifetime SP ID is your permanent SPIKE account identifier.

Sign in

Enter your email and password, or use an available social sign-in option. Passwords are case-sensitive.

Create account

Choose your display name, email and password, agree to the displayed terms, then verify the email code.

SP ID

After verification, SPIKE gives you a lifetime SP ID. You can copy it from your profile.

Password recovery

Use “Forgot password?” to receive a recovery link. The dedicated recovery page lets you choose a new password.

Never give another person your password or temporary verification/recovery code. SPIKE support should not need your password.

📰 Feed, search & discovery

The Feed is the main discovery surface. It combines posts, stories, recommendations and creation tools.

✨ For You

Your personalized feed. Ranking can respond to your interests and interactions.

🔎 Discover

Explore people, posts and topics beyond your usual feed.

🔥 Trending

Find content receiving strong current attention.

🎬 Reels

Browse video-focused content.

📍 Nearby

Opt-in local discovery. Location-based posts need location data to appear.

📊 Insights / 🏆 Progress / ⭐ Creator

Where available, review performance, gamification progress and creator-oriented tools.

Feed controls

You can switch among Latest, Following, Popular, Trending and Saved views. Feed controls can also include time windows, following-only and sensitive-content preferences.

Search & AI

The Feed's AI/search surface can answer SPIKE questions and help search posts, people and topics. The local writing assistant can polish a draft, add a hook, shorten copy or suggest hashtags without requiring an external AI API key.

✍️ Posts, media & stories

SPIKE supports text posts, photos, videos, links and 24-hour Stories.

Create a post

Use Create, add text and media, optionally add a link, then publish.

Media Studio

Preview selected media, add more items, rotate, filter, crop, mute video and choose a layout.

AI Assist

Polish a draft, add a hook, shorten it or suggest hashtags.

Save draft

Keep unfinished work for later instead of publishing immediately.

Schedule

Schedule supported posts and Story sharing for a chosen time.

Content Center

Review drafts, scheduled content and published performance.

Stories

Stories expire after 24 hours. You can create a Story from a photo/video and optional audio. Story actions can include sharing, sharing a Story, scheduling Story sharing, and deleting your own Story.

Sharing

Signals can be passed privately to friends, into a Room where supported, or as a copied Signal link. Passing a Signal sends it onward with the SPIKE Pass flow.

Quality beats volume. A clear idea, useful caption and relevant media usually create a better experience than posting repeatedly just to increase activity.

👥 Friends, profiles & connections

The Friends page helps you manage connections, pending requests, online people and suggestions.

Friend requests

Review pending requests and accept or decline them.

Suggestions

Discover registered SPIKE people you may want to connect with.

Profiles

Open a profile to view identity, posts, media, About information and public activity.

QR connection

Your profile can display a SPIKE QR code. A nearby person can scan it and connect instantly when the feature is available.

Share profile

Share your profile through the device share sheet or copy a profile link.

Block

Use profile actions to block a member when needed. Blocking can restrict interaction.

💬 Messages, media & calls

Private messaging is designed for one-to-one conversations with your friends and supported connections.

Send

Send text, photos, videos, files and voice notes.

Message actions

Reply, react, edit supported messages, pin, save/unsave, translate, copy, delete and report.

Conversation filters

Use All, Unread, Pinned, Archived, Friends and Saved views.

Drafts & scheduling

Save message drafts and schedule supported messages for later.

Voice notes

Record a voice note, review the recording state, cancel if needed, and send.

Voice/video calls

Call supported friends, accept incoming calls, decline them, mute your microphone, toggle your camera and end the call.

Only share sensitive information with people you trust. A private conversation is still a conversation with another human who can screenshot or forward what you send.

🔔 Notifications & activity

The Notifications page centralizes activity alerts.

AllUnreadAnnouncementsMentionsSystem

You can mark notifications read, clear them, or delete read items. Settings can also control message sounds, incoming/outgoing call sounds and browser-level notifications when supported.

🏠 Rooms — find your community

Rooms are public community spaces organized around topics and shared activity.

Discover

Browse live communities and trending Rooms.

Joined

Return to Rooms you already joined.

Following

Keep track of Rooms you follow.

My Rooms

See communities you own/manage once eligible.

Joining a Room

Open a Room, review its information and join when you want to participate. You may need a Room Account before joining, reading or sending messages in Room chat.

Room Account

A Room Account gives you a Room-specific handle, display name and optional bio. New Room Accounts start at Novice and can earn Room XP through Room activity.

Creating a Room

Room creation is a creator feature. The Creator area shows your live qualification progress and the requirements needed to unlock the Creator Tool, including an account-age requirement and a creator challenge. The exact live checklist shown in the app is authoritative.

💬 Room chat — the full toolkit

Once you join a Room, chat becomes a live community experience with channels, presence, moderation, discovery and optional premium features.

# Channels

Switch between Room conversation channels.

⌕ Search

Search loaded Room messages for words or phrases.

👥 Members

See Room members, online state and available public identity information.

📊 Polls

Vote in active polls. Where permitted, Room staff can create and manage them.

🔥 Contributors

See active community contributors.

SPIKE Room Moment

Set a device-local pulse such as Building, Learning, Working or Exploring.

📅 Events

View and participate in community events where available.

📌 Pins & saves

Pin supported messages and save messages for later.

↩ Replies

Reply to a message and follow conversation threads.

🎁 Gifts

Send available gifts to Room members using Coins. Recipients can receive Gems according to the Room's live economy.

🏆 Top Ranking

Open live Room ranking recommendations showing members worth following, gifting or connecting with based on the Room's current ranking signals.

✨ Ask SPIKE

Use the Room assistant when available for smart help.

Member actions

Tap a member to view their profile, mention them, copy their username, share their profile, mute them locally, send a gift or open Top Ranking recommendations. Reporting is available when appropriate.

Respect the Room

Public Rooms are community spaces. Follow the displayed rules, avoid spam/scams/harassment, and use report tools when something genuinely violates the rules.

🌟 Creator path

SPIKE's Creator area is designed for members who want to build communities rather than only participate in them.

Open Rooms → Creator

Review your live qualification status.

Complete the displayed requirements

The app tracks your progress. One visible requirement is an account age of at least 1 year 6 months.

Pass the Creator Challenge

The current challenge uses community-safety scenarios. The visible pass threshold is 80%.

Create your Room

Once unlocked, provide a name, emoji, category, tags, description, rules and optional media.

A strong creator is consistent, clear, fair and useful. Good rules and good moderation matter more than raw message volume.

🛤️ Choose your SPIKE path

You do not need to use every feature. Choose the path that fits how you want to participate.

🗣️ Social member

Discover people, build genuine connections, message friends and participate in Rooms.

✍️ Creator

Publish consistently, improve your profile, learn what your audience values and build a recognizable voice.

🏠 Community builder

Grow a Room around a clear purpose, welcome members, host useful conversations and maintain healthy culture.

🏆 Progress-focused member

Complete daily tasks, check in consistently, earn achievements and climb the level roadmap without farming activity.

👀 Casual member

Browse, react, follow conversations and participate whenever you have something useful to add.

🤝 Connector

Prioritize thoughtful introductions and relationships rather than collecting connections for a number.

You can switch paths at any time. SPIKE progress should support your real participation, not force you into a single style.

🏆 XP, levels, ranks, badges & streaks

The Gamification Hub shows your authoritative progress, including XP, level, rank, streaks, daily tasks, weekly challenges, achievements, roadmap, leaderboard and XP history.

Milestones

The current progression roadmap reaches Level 10 at 5,000 XP and Level 100 at 100,000 XP. Intermediate thresholds are maintained by SPIKE's live progression system.

Daily check-in

Check in once per day to maintain your streak. Eligible XP can receive a streak multiplier, and streak milestones can award bonus XP.

Daily tasks

Complete the tasks shown in the Hub. Task names and rewards can change, so the live task card is the source of truth.

Achievements

Achievements are one-time milestones for activity such as connections, creation, engagement, levels and streaks. The Hub shows whether each achievement is unlocked.

Leaderboard

The Gamification Hub shows the current top users by XP. Rankings are competitive and can change as members earn progress.

📈 How progression fits together

SPIKE's progression systems are easiest to understand as one connected loop.

Participate

Post, connect, converse, join communities and complete useful tasks.

Earn progress

Eligible activity can award XP, while streaks and tasks can add structured progression.

Level up

Your XP total maps to a level using the SPIKE level roadmap.

Advance your rank

Levels belong to rank bands such as Newcomer, Explorer, Connector, Contributor, Influencer, Elite, Leader, Pioneer, Trailblazer and SPIKE Legend.

Unlock achievements

Milestones recognize meaningful progress such as levels, connections, creation, engagement and streaks.

Build reputation through consistency

Long-term quality matters more than short bursts of repetitive activity.

Do not assume every action earns XP. Rewards and limits can change as SPIKE evolves, and server-side rules are authoritative.

🥇 Top-ranking & visibility recommendations

If your goal is to become a consistently high-ranking, high-quality SPIKE member, optimize for genuine value rather than tricks.

1. Complete your identity

Use a clear name, useful bio, avatar and relevant profile details.

2. Publish useful content

Post ideas, stories, media or links that give people a reason to stop, read and return.

3. Build real relationships

Connect with people you actually want in your network. Follow up with meaningful conversation.

4. Participate in Rooms

Join discussions, answer questions, react thoughtfully and contribute to community events or polls.

5. Maintain your streak

Use the daily check-in and complete useful tasks consistently instead of bingeing activity.

6. Protect quality

Avoid spam, repetitive comments, engagement bait and artificial activity. Sustainable reputation wins.

7. Use discovery intelligently

Study what performs well, then make your own original version instead of copying people.

8. Use premium tools responsibly

Boosts and premium presentation can increase visibility where offered, but they do not replace quality or guarantee a ranking position.

Top-ranking formula: complete profile + consistent quality + meaningful connections + Room participation + healthy streak + respectful behavior.

📅 What should I do today?

A simple daily routine keeps SPIKE useful without turning it into a race to generate activity.

Check in

Use Daily Check-in once for the day and protect your streak when it matters to you.

Review notifications

Respond to the people and conversations that actually deserve your attention.

Complete useful daily tasks

Pick tasks naturally. Do not create empty activity simply to collect XP.

Make one meaningful contribution

Publish something useful, answer a question, help in a Room or have a genuine conversation.

Review your progress

Check XP, achievements or streaks occasionally rather than obsessing over every point.

Quality test: if you would not do the action without the XP reward, reconsider whether it is valuable participation.

⚽ SPIKE Predictor

The Predictor ranks football fixtures and supported prediction markets using a model confidence signal.

Over 0.5Over 1.5Over 2.5Under 2.5BTTSDouble ChanceDraw No Bet1X2HT/FTCorrect Score

Use league and market filters, compare today's fixtures and review the confidence labels. High confidence means a stronger model signal; it is not a guarantee of an outcome.

Predictions can be wrong. Treat confidence as information, not certainty, and never risk money you cannot afford to lose.

🔒 Privacy, safety & control

Use Settings and profile privacy controls to decide how much of your presence and profile activity you expose.

Online status

Choose whether permitted people can see when you are online.

Messages

Choose who can start private conversations: Everyone, Friends or Nobody.

Calls

Choose who can call you: Everyone, Friends or Nobody.

Profile visibility

Choose Public, Friends or Private visibility where supported.

Posts & media

Control who can view your posts and profile media.

Friends visibility

Control who can view your connections.

Profile discovery

Choose whether your profile can appear in discovery.

Feed controls

Manage sensitive-content categories and following-only behavior where available.

Safety tools

Report Signals, messages or Room content when appropriate. You can also block users. In Rooms, follow the displayed rules and use moderation/report flows rather than escalating conflict.

Privacy settings reduce exposure; they cannot control what another person does with information you voluntarily send them. Think before sharing passwords, codes, financial details, private documents or sensitive personal information.

🛠️ Troubleshooting

The page says I am offline or content will not load.

Check your connection, wait for the network to return, then retry. Avoid repeatedly submitting the same action while a connection is unstable.

My Room chat is not updating.

Use Refresh, check your membership, and verify that the Room is still available. Live connections can be interrupted temporarily.

I cannot send a Room message.

Make sure you joined the Room and have a Room Account. A Room can also be temporarily locked or slowed by its community controls.

I forgot my password.

Use Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the recovery link. The recovery page validates the password requirements before saving.

I did not receive a verification code.

Check spam/junk folders, make sure the email address is correct, and use the resend option after its cooldown. Only the newest valid code should be used.

My XP or rank looks wrong.

Refresh the Gamification Hub. Progress is authoritative to the live gamification system, so do not rely on a manually calculated total.

A prediction says high confidence. Is it guaranteed?

No. The Predictor explicitly describes confidence as a model estimate, not certainty.

Something feels unsafe.

Stop engaging, use block/report tools where appropriate, and protect your private information. Do not retaliate or publish someone else's private details.

💎 Best-practice checklist

Daily

Check in, review notifications, answer meaningful messages, and participate naturally.

Weekly

Review your profile, clean saved items, join useful Room discussions and check your progress.

For creators

Write clear rules, welcome members, moderate consistently and build useful community culture.

For growth

Prefer quality posts and genuine relationships over repetitive engagement.

For privacy

Review Settings after major changes to your life, audience or comfort level.

For safety

Block/report abuse, scams or harassment and avoid sharing credentials or verification codes.

The strongest SPIKE account is not the loudest one. It is the one that people trust, enjoy, learn from and want to return to.

❓ Quick FAQ

Where do I see my level and badge?

Open Profile → SPIKE Progress or open the full Gamification Hub. The Hub shows the complete rank and badge roadmap.

Where do I change privacy settings?

Open Settings → Privacy & Access. Profile editing also exposes privacy controls when editing your profile.

Where do I find my Rooms?

Open Rooms, then use Discover, Joined, Following or My Rooms.

How do I create a Story?

From Feed/Create, choose Story, add text and optional photo/video/audio, then publish. Stories expire after 24 hours.

How do I contact someone privately?

Use Messages and start a conversation with an eligible friend/connection. Your message permissions depend on your privacy settings and theirs.

Can I improve my ranking by paying?

Some Room experiences offer premium presentation, VIP, Coins or Profile Boost features. These can add visibility or presentation options where offered, but they do not guarantee a leaderboard position or replace genuine participation.
